selectedArtifactVerification: All eight downloaded current artifacts matched the registry SHA-256 fingerprints exactly.

evidence: ArenaPartyManager keeps running-session membership on playerLeave and applies a bounded offline timeout rather than silently dropping ownership.

installPlayerRecovery retries initialSpawn recovery while the session is not yet gameplay-ready; once offense_game_running is true it restores controls, teleports to the authoritative checkpoint, restores the arena tag/control item, and clears recovery markers.
Script-reload recovery explicitly resumes session_phase=intro by calling manager.onSetupComplete().
results.closureReason: The cinematic may continue while the player is offline, but the selected artifact has an explicit deferred recovery path that waits for gameplay readiness and reconstructs the player from authoritative session state. No player-visible contradiction remains source-grounded.

evidence: Arena state explicitly tracks bed state, dead, eliminated and disconnected independently.
playerLeave routes through disconnect(), marks a running member disconnected and clears pending respawn ownership.
destroyBed() eliminates already-dead team members and refreshes team survival state; reconnect() requires the same run, an unfinished match and an eligible surviving team.
playerSpawn routes through canReconnect/reconnect before gameplay restoration and refuses invalid ownership.
results.closureReason: No source-grounded ordering permits a stale respawn authority to override bed/elimination state. Native event ordering alone, without a contradictory reachable state, is not sufficient reason to retain a manual test.

evidence: playerLeave calls arena.removePlayer(), which removes arena membership and invokes the session leave callback; the map does not resume the disconnected player as an active participant.
On later spawn, session lookup is derived from current arena membership; a removed player has no active session and is routed through lobby cleanup.
Kit application clears inventory/equipment before applying the selected kit, and persistent match cleanup is retried on spawn when necessary.
results.closureReason: The proposed death-plus-reconnect continuity scenario is not an authored reconnect path in this map. Disconnect exits membership, so there is no supported active-session kit resume path that can leak or duplicate kit state.

evidence: createArenaLoadingPlan derives required chunks from spawn/path/gameplay coverage and identifies chunks outside the reliable gameplay range.
Those out-of-range chunks become retained keepAliveAreas.
ArenaLoadingCoordinator adds the retained ticking area before session readiness and stores it in _retainedAreas after successful verification.
Readiness probes and entity/path entries are revalidated before onReady; retained ticking areas are released only for the matching session/generation.
results.closureReason: Remote simulation is explicitly owned by the current artifact through generated retained ticking-area coverage plus readiness verification. The earlier runtime probe is no longer an irreducible question.

evidence: purchaseUpgrade performs coin removal and equipment replacement synchronously with no await/yield between debit and commit/refund.
Every failed armor/weapon/tool replacement immediately refunds the removed coins.
Upgrade scoreboard state is written only after successful replacement.
Reconnect restores the active session from persisted arena/session ownership; there is no interruptible async transaction between debit and equipment commit.
results.closureReason: A player disconnect cannot interleave inside the synchronous debit→replace→score/refund transaction. The proposed immediate-disconnect test therefore does not expose an unresolved transactional boundary.

evidence: The antechamber/key state machine serializes playerId, stage and elapsedTicks; hasKey and doorOpen are derived from that authoritative stage.
playerLeave pauses and persists the objective state.
playerSpawn resumes the same owner, restores controls/item state and reconciles key display, door lock/open state and player key representation.
Startup restoration loads persisted objective state and immediately reconciles the world representation; invalid persisted state is cleared rather than partially resumed.
results.closureReason: Key/item, door/world representation and player state are explicitly reconciled from one persisted state machine on spawn and reload. No split-authority state remains unaccounted.

evidence: During active or round_transition playerLeave is handled by handleActiveDisconnect(), which removes the member from the active session rather than preserving an ambiguous partially-online participant.
The recovery record is marked pendingCleanup and reconnect policy routes pendingCleanup to cleanup/selection lobby, not active-round resume.
Round transitions persist a recovery checkpoint before reset commands and only transition back to active after reset/player resume work.
results.closureReason: Disconnect during the round transition intentionally exits the active membership and reconnect is routed to cleanup, so prior-round loadout/score cannot leak through an authored active-session resume path.

evidence: A new session schedules scheduleFullBaseline(..., 'new_session', ...) before gameplay arrival.
ResetCoordinator owns Quarry, Ascent, Beacon, Relay and transient cleanup resets and has matching verify functions.
The baseline runner visits required scopes, waits for chunk readiness, executes reset+verification, retries failed scopes, and calls onReady only after the full baseline is verified.
Reconnect during an in-progress baseline resumes the same baseline reason before gameplay handoff.
results.closureReason: Second-run gameplay is gated behind a verified full baseline reset. Residual world/objective state is therefore blocked by an explicit reset-and-verify owner rather than left to runtime chance.

interpretation: Fresh selected-artifact inspection eliminated all eight speculative runtime probes. They were useful prioritization prompts, but none retained an exact runtime-native deciding fact after deterministic reduction. This does not assert runtime bug-free behavior; it means no current evidence justifies asking the user to test these scenarios manually.
